subject: VoiceMem donor mechanisms for agency, perception, familiarity and realtime voice

routes.use: SUCCESSOR/INTEGRATION INPUT only: prospective cue evaluation must remain a separate evidence producer.
SUCCESSOR INPUT: wake on evidence-bound prospective cue without conflating cue detection with effect authority.
REVIEW INPUT: lazy perception and quality-gated identity evidence.
FALSIFIER INPUT: UNKNOWN/candidate identity must remain distinct from observation/identity fact.
SUCCESSOR INPUT: scene/presence changes can produce prospective cue candidates.
REVIEW INPUT: separate user facts/traits from assistant response experience.
SUCCESSOR/RUNTIME INPUT: speculative local retrieval, cancellation on speech resume, transport framing.
FALSIFIER INPUT: soft familiarity must not become person identity; quality/observation-count gating.

observed_mechanisms.source_observation: SceneTrigger stores a pending future intention keyed to a coarse scene plus optional specific label; e.g. bus can require transit+bus so subway does not fire it.
observed_mechanisms.transfer: Bind F2 DeferredIntent.revisit_condition_ref to a typed prospective-condition object. Perception/Presence may emit a CueMatchCandidate; a separate deterministic evaluator can produce revisit eligibility. Eligibility is not an effect and must re-enter Agency/Pulse/EffectGate normally.
observed_mechanisms.counterhypothesis: Continuous cue monitoring can waste compute and over-trigger on noisy sensors.
observed_mechanisms.cheapest_discriminator: Synthetic scene stream with near-miss cues, stale generations and exact-label cases; require zero false fires at the intent-evaluation boundary and measure monitoring cost.

observed_mechanisms.source_observation: Very short speaker windows are skipped because noisy embeddings frequently landed in candidate range and previously fragmented one person into many identities; donor comments explicitly prefer not knowing the speaker to contaminating the identity store.
observed_mechanisms.transfer: For WP701/WP706, maintain OBSERVATION -> CANDIDATE_MATCH -> RECONCILED_IDENTITY as distinct states. Soft similarity never mints identity. Quality, observation count, generation and provenance gates should be explicit.
observed_mechanisms.counterhypothesis: Conservative UNKNOWN may reduce personalization availability.
observed_mechanisms.cheapest_discriminator: Open-set speaker/perception fixture with short/noisy samples, repeated clean samples and explicit-name conflicts; score false merge, false split and unknown rate separately.

observed_mechanisms.source_observation: Voiceprint profile uses quality-weighted cumulative averaging while evidence is sparse, caps accumulated weight so later updates behave like an EMA, and splits a new subcentroid when no existing mode is similar enough; excessive subcentroids are merged.
observed_mechanisms.transfer: Reusable candidate for soft familiarity/state prototypes, not canonical identity. Store prototype generation, support mass and quality provenance. Separate mode discovery from identity reconciliation.
observed_mechanisms.counterhypothesis: EMA-like adaptation can slowly absorb poisoned/misattributed samples.
observed_mechanisms.cheapest_discriminator: Poisoning/drift test: inject low-quality cross-identity samples and verify canonical identity does not move; compare prototype movement with/without quality caps and admission fences.

observed_mechanisms.source_observation: After a user says they will play a song, a following sound-only VAD turn may inherit a short-lived expected-music cue because speech and music are separate turns. The expectation is used as weak context, not tune identity.
observed_mechanisms.transfer: Presence/Perception may consume bounded prior-state expectations as relevance priors only. Expectation != observation and must expire/fence by causal turn/generation.
observed_mechanisms.counterhypothesis: Expectation can bias perception into confirming itself.
observed_mechanisms.cheapest_discriminator: Expectation-present/no-signal and expectation-conflict fixtures must preserve UNKNOWN/contradiction rather than hallucinated observation.

observed_mechanisms.source_observation: Streaming code starts a local speculative reply/retrieval around a short silence window, cancels speculative work if speech resumes, and keeps the path local/no-network. It exploits VAD waiting time rather than adding a new post-turn delay.
observed_mechanisms.transfer: WP705/WP505 can define reversible SPECULATIVE_CANDIDATE work during natural wait windows. It must be cancellation-safe, generation-bound, side-effect free and must never call EffectGate early.
observed_mechanisms.counterhypothesis: Speculation may increase CPU/GPU contention and worsen end-to-end latency on low-resource hosts.
observed_mechanisms.cheapest_discriminator: A/B trace: no-prefetch vs bounded-prefetch under identical audio/compute load. Measure p50/p95 reply-ready latency, cancellation waste, resource contention and stale-candidate rejection.

observed_mechanisms.source_observation: StreamState exposes perception properties lazily so expensive perception is not paid unless consumed; right-brain speculative context may reuse prior-turn affect because full acoustic emotion analysis is too expensive for the immediate speculative window.
observed_mechanisms.transfer: Perception heads and HCU cells should declare demand/cost and compute only when a downstream consumer requests them or a policy makes them mandatory. Prior-state reuse must be typed as stale prior evidence, not fresh observation.
observed_mechanisms.counterhypothesis: Lazy computation can miss signals needed by downstream safety/epistemic gating.
observed_mechanisms.cheapest_discriminator: Dependency manifest test: every mandatory consumer declares required head; missing demanded evidence yields UNKNOWN/HOLD, never silent reuse.

observed_mechanisms.source_observation: If no textual facts are extracted but a sound/tune is perceived, the orchestrator materializes a minimal vector/cognitive record so downstream tags are not orphaned by foreign-key assumptions; unknown sound is not automatically called music.
observed_mechanisms.transfer: Typed Entry should support modality-native evidence even when no linguistic fact exists. Do not force all perception through text serialization.
observed_mechanisms.counterhypothesis: Minimal placeholder memories can become junk if downstream semantics are underspecified.
observed_mechanisms.cheapest_discriminator: Require modality/type/provenance and no fact classification; verify retrieval does not expose placeholder as a textual world fact.

observed_mechanisms.source_observation: Streaming TTS reassembles byte chunks on PCM16 sample boundaries because HTTP chunks may arrive at odd byte lengths.
observed_mechanisms.transfer: Voice runtime receipts should bind transport framing/codec/sample-rate and reject partial-frame corruption. This is a concrete low-level reliability donor, not a cognition concept.
observed_mechanisms.counterhypothesis: Current F2 transport may already normalize frames upstream.
observed_mechanisms.cheapest_discriminator: Inject odd-sized byte chunks and compare reconstructed PCM digest to reference.

observed_mechanisms.source_observation: Startup probes classify missing dependency/model/credential as SKIP, slow as SLOW and execution anomaly as FAIL instead of conflating unavailable infrastructure with product logic failure.
observed_mechanisms.transfer: Use typed runtime preflight outcomes in voice/perception host diagnostics: SKIP/UNAVAILABLE != FAIL; SLOW != logic regression.
observed_mechanisms.counterhypothesis: SKIP could hide a mandatory dependency.
observed_mechanisms.cheapest_discriminator: Mark requirement level separately; mandatory+SKIP -> BLOCKED, optional+SKIP -> DEGRADED, actual exception -> FAIL.

do_not_import: Do not let acoustic similarity or a candidate voiceprint write canonical person identity.
Do not let scene-trigger eligibility execute an external effect directly.
Do not treat prior-turn emotion as current observation; it is stale prior evidence only.
Do not use speculative prefetch paths for irreversible or network/provider effects without separate current authorization.
Do not treat VoiceMem audio-runtime comments as F2 target-runtime evidence.
